intent: REFACTOR TelemetryProperties: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Externalized configuration binding for all operational parameters (no hardcoded durations or capacities elsewhere). @ConfigurationProperties(prefix="pulsestream.telemetry") @Validated immutable record TelemetryProperties(Duration reorderWindow, int reorderBufferCapacity, Window window, Channels channels, Map<String, Boundary> boundaries). Nested records: Window(Duration size, Duration slide); Channels(int validatedSamples, int sequencedSamples, int backfillDetections, int closedWindows, int revisionsAppended, int streamPublications, int streamSubscriberBuffer); Boundary(Double min, Double max) inclusive, null side = unbounded. Bean validation: durations non-null and positive, capacities positive, window.size >= window.slide, boundaries non-empty with min <= max when both set. Boundary keys are lower-case metric names (Sensor Metric Boundary definitions owned by Telemetry Intake & Validation).
